records.context: Call before the panel is destroyed so a running QThread keeps an owner. The active stream's thread is passed to the drain helper with a 3000 ms wait and each retired thread with a 1000 ms wait. Threads still running after those waits are parked by the helper rather than terminated; this method does not guarantee that every thread has exited when it returns.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ai_chat_panel.AIChatPanel.shutdown#1
records.source: Call before the panel is destroyed so a running QThread keeps an owner. Threads still running after those waits are parked by the helper rather than terminated; this method does not guarantee that every thread has exited when it returns.
records.translation: Kalla skal á þetta áður en spjaldinu er eytt svo QThread sem er enn í keyrslu haldi eiganda. Þráður virka streymisins er sendur í hjálparfallið fyrir tæmingu með 3000 ms bið og hver aflagður þráður með 1000 ms bið. Þræðir sem eru enn í keyrslu eftir þessar biðir eru settir í geymslu af hjálparfallinu í stað þess að vera stöðvaðir; aðferðin tryggir ekki að allir þræðir hafi lokið keyrslu þegar hún skilar.

records.context: A settings CSV stores ``repr(value)``, so ``classes`` comes back as the text ``"['nc', 'pc']"``, which the string branch below parses. records.context: The pointer arguments are not optional in practice. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_cascade.CascadeEngine.render#1
records.source: THE POINTER ARGUMENTS ARE NOT OPTIONAL IN PRACTICE. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.translation: BENDILSVIÐFÖNGIN ERU EKKI VALFRJÁLS Í REYND. Vinnuþráðurinn sendir öll tíu sem staðsetningarviðföng til þeirrar vélar sem mynstrið valdi, en þessi undirskrift endaði við sex -- því vakti hver rammi TypeError, villumerkið var sent, engin mynd barst og viðmótsgræjan málaði varalitinn sinn. Þess vegna var CPU-kaskaðan svört meðan GPU-útgáfan virkaði og CPU-brautarhringurinn fylgdi músinni.

records.context: The table shape supports multiple organelles up to the slot limit. In a flat vocabulary each new organelle is twenty new settings that every tooltip table and translation catalog has to include; here it is one column, and the number of questions does not change. :meth:`ObjectSettingsGrid.add_organelle` adds one, and it retains stored answers for that slot or seeds a missing slot from the preceding organelle.

records.translation: Uppbygging töflunnar styður mörg frumulíffæri upp að hámarksfjölda sæta. Með aðskildum heitum stillinga þýðir hvert nýtt frumulíffæri tuttugu nýjar stillingar sem hver tafla yfir vísbendingar og hver þýðingaskrá verður að innihalda; hér er það einn dálkur og fjöldi spurninga breytist ekki. :meth:`ObjectSettingsGrid.add_organelle` bætir einu frumulíffæri við og heldur vistuðum gildum þess sætis eða fyllir sæti sem vantar með gildum frá næsta frumulíffæri á undan.

records.context: The view enforces two rules; breaking either would corrupt a settings file rather than only display it wrongly:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.object_settings_grid#4
records.source: The view enforces two rules; breaking either would corrupt a settings file rather than only display it wrongly:
records.translation: Sýnin framfylgir tveimur reglum; brot á annarri hvorri myndi skemma stillingaskrá í stað þess að birta hana aðeins rangt:

records.context: **A value keeps its type.** ``cell_diameter`` is an int, ``organelle_ cellprob_threshold`` is a float, and a cell edited in a table arrives as a string. Writing ``"12"`` where ``12`` was changes the meaning of the settings file without notice, and the workflow reading it either coerces silently or fails far from here.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.object_settings_grid#5
records.source: **A value keeps its type.** ``cell_diameter`` is an int, ``organelle_ cellprob_threshold`` is a float, and a cell edited in a table arrives as a string. Writing ``"12"`` where ``12`` was changes the meaning of the settings file without notice, and the pipeline reading it either coerces silently or fails far from here.
records.translation: **Gildi heldur gagnagerð sinni.** ``cell_diameter`` er int, ``organelle_ cellprob_threshold`` er float, og reitur sem er breytt í töflu skilar streng. Ef ``"12"`` er skrifað þar sem ``12`` stóð breytist merking stillingaskrárinnar án viðvörunar. Vinnslukeðjan sem les hana annaðhvort umbreytir gagnagerðinni þegjandi eða bregst mun síðar.

records.context: **A question an object does not ask stays absent.** ``cytoplasm`` has no channel, no diameter and no detection method -- it is derived, cell minus the rest, not found in a channel. Those cells are blank and not editable, because writing a value there invents a structured-data name nothing reads.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.object_settings_grid#6
records.source: **A question an object does not ask stays absent.** ``cytoplasm`` has no channel, no diameter and no detection method -- it is derived, cell minus the rest, not found in a channel. Those cells are blank and not editable, because writing a value there invents a key nothing reads.
records.translation: **Spurning sem á ekki við fyrirbæri er áfram fjarverandi.** ``cytoplasm`` hefur hvorki rás, þvermál né greiningaraðferð -- það er leitt af frumunni að frádregnu öðru, en ekki greint í rás. Þessir töflureitir eru auðir og óbreytanlegir, því gildi þar myndi búa til lykil sem ekkert les.

Graph Builder teiknar síðan grafið án þess að vita að um PCA sé að ræða.

records.context: The one constant every arrow and the unit circle are multiplied by.

records.translation: Sá eini fasti sem allar örvar og einingarhringurinn eru margfölduð með.

records.context: Scores use the feature scaling chosen for the decomposition and correlations are in ``[-1, 1]``; there is no conversion between them, so a biplot has to pick a display scale. It is picked once, from the drawn axes, so that the longest arrow spans ``fill`` of the shorter half-range — and applied to the circle too, so the circle shows the scale on application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view.arrow_scale#1
records.source: Scores use the feature scaling chosen for the decomposition and correlations are in ``[-1, 1]``; there is no conversion between them, so a biplot has to pick a display scale. It is picked once, from the drawn axes, so that the longest arrow spans ``fill`` of the shorter half-range — and applied to the circle too, so the circle shows the scale on screen.
records.translation: Þáttagildin nota þá kvörðun breyta sem valin var fyrir þáttunina og fylgnin er á bilinu ``[-1, 1]``; enginn umreikningur tengir þessar stærðir, svo tvírit þarf að velja birtingarkvarða. Hann er valinn einu sinni út frá teiknuðum ásum þannig að lengsta örin spannar hlutfallið ``fill`` af styttra hálfa ásbilinu. Sami kvarði er notaður fyrir hringinn svo hann sýni kvarðann á skjánum.

records.translation: ``spacr.utils.annotate_conditions`` tengir tilraunaskilyrði við brunna með auðkennum raða og dálka, svo þetta er aðeins hægt að útbúa þegar hvert skilyrði nær yfir heilar raðir eða heila dálka. Slembiröðun er ekki hægt að lýsa þannig, og þá er ``expressible=False`` skilað með ástæðunni í stað nálgunar sem myndi merkja brunna rangt.

records.context: Find regression result tables beneath a path.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results.find_results_tables#0
records.source: Find regression result tables beneath a path.
records.translation: Finnur töflur með aðhvarfsniðurstöðum undir slóð.

records.context: path : path-like Results CSV, run directory, or parent directory to search. An explicit CSV is returned first, followed by recognised result tables beside it; missing paths and non-CSV files return no matches. max_depth : int, default=MAX_SEARCH_DEPTH Maximum directory depth to descend below ``path``. The root directory is still inspected when this value is zero. limit : int, default=MAX_CANDIDATES Stop walking after at least this many candidate tables have been collected. All recognised tables in the final run directory are kept, so the returned count can be slightly larger than this value.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results.find_results_tables#2
records.source: path : path-like Results CSV, run directory, or parent directory to search. An explicit CSV is returned first, followed by recognised result tables beside it; missing paths and non-CSV files return no matches. max_depth : int, default=MAX_SEARCH_DEPTH Maximum directory depth to descend below ``path``. The root directory is still inspected when this value is zero. limit : int, default=MAX_CANDIDATES Stop walking after at least this many candidate tables have been collected. All recognised tables in the final run directory are kept, so the returned count can be slightly larger than this value.
records.translation: path : path-like CSV-skrá með niðurstöðum, keyrslumappa eða yfirmappa sem á að leita í. CSV-skrá sem er tilgreind sérstaklega er skilað fyrst, síðan þekktum niðurstöðutöflum í sömu möppu; slóðir sem eru ekki til og skrár sem eru ekki CSV skila engum niðurstöðum. max_depth : int, default=MAX_SEARCH_DEPTH Mesta dýpt undirmappa sem farið er í undir ``path``. Rótarmappan er skoðuð þótt þetta gildi sé núll. limit : int, default=MAX_CANDIDATES Hætta leit eftir að að minnsta kosti þessum fjölda mögulegra taflna hefur verið safnað. Öllum þekktum töflum í síðustu keyrslumöppunni er haldið, svo fjöldinn sem er skilað getur verið örlítið meiri en þetta gildi.

records.context: list of str Recognised result-table paths. For directory searches, runs are ordered by the newest modification time among their tables, and tables within each run follow :data:`RESULT_FILENAMES`. An explicitly supplied CSV stays first, followed by its recognised siblings in that same filename order.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results.find_results_tables#4
records.source: list of str Recognised result-table paths. For directory searches, runs are ordered by the newest modification time among their tables, and tables within each run follow :data:`RESULT_FILENAMES`. An explicitly supplied CSV stays first, followed by its recognised siblings in that same filename order.
records.translation: list of str Slóðir þekktra niðurstöðutaflna. Við leit í möppum er keyrslum raðað eftir nýjasta breytingartíma meðal taflna þeirra, og töflur innan hverrar keyrslu fylgja :data:`RESULT_FILENAMES`. CSV-skrá sem er tilgreind sérstaklega helst fremst, síðan koma þekktar töflur í sömu möppu í sömu skráarnafnaröð.

records.context: A ``uint8`` picture keeps its image data channel values while being converted to RGB: grayscale is repeated across three image data channels, extra image data channels are dropped after the first three, and missing image data channels are filled with zeros. Other dtypes are stretched from their own minimum to their own maximum: the default for an owner that did not normalise, because normalisation is the owner's business (the live preview has percentiles for it).
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views.to_rgb8#1
records.source: A ``uint8`` picture keeps its channel values while being converted to RGB: grayscale is repeated across three channels, extra channels are dropped after the first three, and missing channels are filled with zeros. Other dtypes are stretched from their own minimum to their own maximum: the default for an owner that did not normalise, because normalisation is the owner's business (the live preview has percentiles for it).
records.translation: Mynd af gerðinni ``uint8`` heldur gildum rásanna þegar henni er breytt í RGB: grátónar eru endurteknir í þremur rásum, umframrásum á eftir fyrstu þremur er sleppt og rásir sem vantar eru fylltar með núllum. Aðrar gagnagerðir eru kvarðaðar frá eigin lágmarki upp í eigið hámark: þetta er sjálfgefið þegar kallandi eining hefur ekki staðlað gildin, því stöðlun er á ábyrgð þeirrar einingar (lifandi forskoðun notar hundraðshlutamörk til þess).

records.context: Render first-run questions in a rounded, pointer-responsive card.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card#0
records.source: Render first-run questions in a rounded, pointer-responsive card.
records.translation: Sýnir spurningar við fyrstu keyrslu á ávölu spjaldi sem bregst við bendlinum.

records.context: The accent follows the corner nearest the pointer. All visual effects are decorative: if a blur, background, or accent cannot be painted, the card continues to host the question controls. The setup dialog collects and saves their answers through :mod:`spacr.qt.setup_screen`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card#1
records.source: The accent follows the corner nearest the pointer. All visual effects are decorative: if a blur, background, or accent cannot be painted, the card continues to host the question controls. The setup dialog collects and saves their answers through :mod:`spacr.qt.setup_screen`.
records.translation: Áherslulínan fylgir horninu sem er næst bendlinum. Allar sjónrænar brellur eru skraut: ef ekki er hægt að teikna móðu, bakgrunn eða áherslulínu heldur spjaldið áfram að hýsa stýringar spurninganna. Uppsetningarglugginn safnar svörunum og vistar þau í gegnum :mod:`spacr.qt.setup_screen`.

records.translation: Sýnir uppsetningarglærurnar þegar skráð staða uppsetningar krefst þess.

records.context: The centralized :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` check compares the answered setup version with the running version. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` additionally requests setup when the terms have never been accepted or have changed since acceptance.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_slides.open_setup_if_needed#1
records.source: The centralized :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` check compares the answered setup version with the running version. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` additionally requests setup when the terms have never been accepted or have changed since acceptance.
records.translation: Miðlæga athugunin :func:`spacr.qt.setup_screen.should_open` ber saman útgáfuna sem þegar hefur verið svarað fyrir í uppsetningu og útgáfuna sem er í keyrslu. :func:`spacr.qt.terms.needs_agreement` biður einnig um uppsetningu ef skilmálarnir hafa aldrei verið samþykktir eða hafa breyst frá samþykkt.
